inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: During an inspection, four children enrolled at the operation did not have a health statement on file for review. The health statements were requested but were not submitted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: During an inspection, one out of four children were missing their physician information on the enrollment form. The updated form was requested but not received.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission (26 TAC §747.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: During an inspection, the primary caregiver has completed seventeen out of thirty hours of annual training for the last annual training year of 9/28/2023 to 9/28/2024. The training was requested but not received.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: Cleaning products were sitting on a shelf that was accessible to children.    Note: This was corrected when the products were moved out of the children's reach.
